steps.content: Murphy is happy.
All her life, people have turned away the moment she drew near as if misfortune had a face and it was hers. No one, not once, has ever said to her:

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: I need your bad luck.
She tucks the photo Lynn gave her with care, nestling it close. The smile creeps up no matter how hard she tries to hold it down.
The air is still thick and damp, yet to her it carries a thread of sweetness now, a trick of the senses, light as a secret. Her feet, too, move with a newfound bounce as she walks among the others.
Just as everyone's ready to head down to the lower levels, a sound comes from far off—that horribly familiar jingling and clattering that makes your teeth ache just hearing it.

steps.speaker: Lynn
steps.content: Huh, that sounds familiar?

steps.speaker: Murphy
steps.content: ...Don't tell me that's the coin bank from yesterday!
Murphy's voice still hangs in the air when the sound surges closer, louder, more insistent. And then, cutting through the dimness, a familiar round silhouette hurtles into view.

steps.speaker: Murphy
steps.content: I-I-it's not actually back for revenge, is it?! I swear I didn't mean to knock it over yesterday!
Her words barely land before it springs, round body recoiling, then exploding forward like a cannonball, a racket of jingles and clangs trailing behind it as it barrels straight at your group.

steps.speaker: Murphy
steps.content: Eek! I'm doomed!

steps.speaker: Lynn
steps.content: Murphy!

Lynn seizes Murphy, who stands paralysed, and wrenches her aside. In the very next heartbeat, the coin bank hurtles past, missing the group by a hair's breadth, and scrapes along the stone wall in a blinding shower of harsh, grating sparks.

steps.speaker: Murphy
steps.content: Phew... that was close! Thanks... Lynn!

steps.speaker: Lynn
steps.content: I-it's nothing! That's... that's what friends do!
Letta has learned from last time. She steps forward in one fluid motion, swings her lantern wide, and brings it down hard against the creature's side.

steps.speaker: Coin Bank
steps.content: Meow!
The lantern is clearly no match for a lamppost in sheer heft, yet Letta has already grown accustomed to this unbridled style of combat.

steps.speaker: Letta
steps.content: Heh. Didn't think it'd actually come back for round two.

steps.speaker: Letta
steps.content: I was expecting one of those stories EMP's always going on about. You know, the "underdog rises up, you'll regret underestimating me" thing. With the coin bank as the tragic hero...

steps.speaker: EMP
steps.content: ...Pretty sure you've read just as many of those as I have, Lantern Girl.
A shriek of pain tears from the coin bank, but it doesn't stop. Head down, it pushes through the blow and drives toward you again, all momentum and fury.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Nice work, everyone! Murphy, you're up!

steps.speaker: Murphy
steps.content: R-right! I'll hit it with my best misfortune! Keep at it, guys!
Her words have barely faded when the coin bank ricochets off the wall, using the momentum to lunge back at an even more vicious angle, its body alive with the chaotic clamor of rattling coins.

steps.speaker: EMP
steps.content: Whoa—Murphy! Wrong target!

steps.speaker: Murphy
steps.content: Ack! Sorry... force of habit! Lemme fix it! Everyone... everyone is totally gonna lose this fight!
